public.text: The section states that national standards selections and bindings are recorded in information-model and terminology components, but it does not address governance of implementation guides, API specifications, transport profiles, security profiles, and workflow definitions.
public.suggestedRevision: Identify a governed national interoperability-specification repository or publication process covering implementation guides, capability statements, profiles, extensions, terminology bindings, transport, security, workflows, and test artefacts.
